Maya R.: noticed a base64 fragment that looks like an AES IV in staging backup index (gs://staging-backups/index-2026-03-20.ndjson).
Tom L.: paste?
Maya R.: `... meta:{iv:\"AAECAwQFBgcICQoLDA0ODw==\"}, backup_id: 20260320-02`
Isha (infra): treat as sensitive. suspending backup-agent push and listing affected objects now.
ScanBot: automated scan: 3 objects matched pattern /iv:\"[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{16,}\"/ across last 30 days.
Tom L.: quick repo grep: backup-agent logs IV when DEBUG=true. looks like helm staging values still had DEBUG on.
Maya R.: immediate plan: 1) remove affected backups (retain audit), 2) rotate service account keys used by agent, 3) create new KMS wrap key and schedule rewrap, 4) tighten bucket IAM to group backup-ops only, 5) patch agent to drop IV logging and deploy.
Isha (infra): doing IAM change and purge of recent objects. opened ticket INFSEC-498 for rotation + rewrap.
Tom L.: will push patch to disable DEBUG and add CI check to prevent DEBUG=true in helm values.
Maya R.: hold external notifications until scan + sample check done. posting updates to INFSEC-498. closing here once rewrap done. :lock:
